ASECNA maintains the AIP nominally but operational reliability is degraded. Score 8: open vector PDF charts via ASECNA (+1 conflict/instability friction).

SV.aip_authority: AAC El Salvador (Autoridad de Aviación Civil) via COCESNA
SV.notes: El Salvador AIP published via COCESNA eAIP (Eurocontrol tool); same architecture as Guatemala/Nicaragua — HTML frameset for GEN/ENR text, SID/STAR/IAP as vector PDF charts in eAIP Maps tree (e.g. MS_AD-2.MSLP SID RWY 25, IAC RNP Z). AAC also maintains aac.gob.sv/aip/ but content is served via COCESNA. Fully open, no account. AIRAC and non-AIRAC amendments published 2024-2026. Score 6 (open vector PDF in eAIP) +1 for frameset complexity = 7.

SZ.notes: ESWACAA exists (statutory body since 2009, CANSO member) but no public online AIP or eAIP found. Matsapha airport (FDMS) is domestic-only since 2014; new King Mswati III International Airport (FDSK) opened 2014. AIP appears to be available only on direct request. No instrument procedure charts discoverable via public channels; third-party sources (Navigraph/Jeppesen) are the practical route.

GP.notes: Guadeloupe (TFFR) is covered by SIA France under the CAR-SAM-NAM eAIP, freely accessible without login. HTML aerodrome sections reference procedure data but SID/STAR charts are embedded PDF links. Structure mirrors metropolitan France SIA eAIP — parseable but irregular. URL pattern: sia.aviation-civile.gouv.fr/media/dvd/eAIP_[DATE]/CAR-SAM-NAM/...

MH.aip_authority: Republic of Marshall Islands Directorate of Civil Aviation (RMIDCA) / FAA (procedure publisher)
MH.notes: No national AIP published by RMI. FAA publishes instrument procedures for PKMJ and PKWA in the Pacific d-TPP (open PDF) and NASR CIFP (open ARINC-424) under Compact of Free Association authority. CIFP is open download, no account. Confidence medium: FAA notes records may be incomplete for non-US facilities.

ME.aip_authority: UCAA / SMATSA llc (Serbia and Montenegro Air Traffic Services)
ME.notes: Montenegro eAIP is published jointly with Serbia by SMATSA at smatsa.rs. Web portal is openly accessible without login; current cycle (Jun 2026) confirmed live. Standard EUROCONTROL eAIP HTML with AD-2 sections for Montenegro airports (LYTV Tivat, LYPG Podgorica). PDF procedure charts embedded within eAIP. ECAC/EAD member; EAD Basic also provides AIXM 5.1. Irregular joint-state structure adds minor friction; score 4.

SC.notes: SCAA publishes AIP Seychelles as PDF directly on scaa.sc (e.g. scaa.sc/files/AIP%20Seychelles.pdf, last major revision 2017). AIRAC amendments published as PDF at irregular intervals. FSIA (Mahe) has ILS, VOR, NDB and RNAV GNSS approaches on RWY 13/31. No eAIP HTML; AIRAC cycle adherence partial. PDF appears text-based (vector), not scanned. Low procedure count: 2 airports (FSIA, FSPP). Confidence medium as site was unreachable during verification.

SB.aip_authority: Civil Aviation Authority of Solomon Islands (CAASI) / Aeropath NZ (AIP manager)
SB.notes: AIP managed by Aeropath New Zealand on behalf of CAASI. Publications must be ordered/purchased through CAASI or via shop.aeropath.aero; no free public download. Format is PDF (vector text, Aeropath standard). No eAIP HTML, no AIXM. Very limited procedure set (Honiara AGGH is primary IFR airport). Score 9 for paid access + formal ordering process + no coded data source. Aeropath shop URL returned 404 at time of verification; confidence medium.

TG.notes: Togo is an ASECNA member state; AIP at aim.asecna.aero. AD-2.DXXX section for Lome/Gnassingbe Eyadema confirmed accessible without login — bilingual HTML tables with aerodrome data valid from APR 2026. SID/STAR/IAP procedure details are in PDF charts under /cartes/atlas/togo/Lome/ (IAC-VOR22, ILC, VLC confirmed). AIXM 4.5 backend per ICAO. Same structure as Benin: open eAIP HTML for aerodrome facts, vector PDF charts for procedures. Score 7: same friction as BJ.

BJ.aip_authority: ASECNA (Agence pour la Sécurité de la Navigation Aérienne en Afrique et à Madagascar)
BJ.notes: Benin is an ASECNA member state; AIP published at aim.asecna.aero as a frameset-based bilingual (FR/EN) eAIP HTML. Procedure charts (SID, STAR, IAP, VAC) are separately served as vector PDFs under the /cartes/atlas/benin/ path — confirmed for DBBB Cotonou (ILS Z RWY 24, VOR, STAR RNAV). HTML AD sections contain aerodrome data tables but SID/STAR procedure details link to PDF chart files (CorelDRAW-generated vector, selectable text). ICAO APIRG paper confirms ASECNA operates an AIXM 4.5 back-end database. HTML browsable without login; offline subscription form exists (paid) but online HTML freely accessible. Score 7: eAIP HTML is open but procedures are only in PDF charts requiring portal navigation; French-primary interface adds friction.

CK.aip_authority: Cook Islands Ministry of Transport / Aeropath (contracted AIS provider)
CK.notes: Cook Islands AIP is a free PDF download via Cook Islands Ministry of Transport and Aeropath shop (NZD $0.00). Current master effective Jun 2024. Covers NCRG Rarotonga and a small number of other aerodromes. PDF is vector/text (bookmarked master file, 5.8 MB). Procedure charts embedded as PDF graphics within the master document. No AIXM or coded data; open vector PDF is the authoritative source.

DJ.aip_authority: AAC – Autorité de l'Aviation Civile de Djibouti
DJ.notes: AAC Djibouti contracted CGX AERO (March 2025) to deliver an eAIP in AIXM 5.1; final authority approval was expected mid-2025 but the cgxaero portal (djibouti-aip.cgxaero.com) returned 503 as of June 2026. The AAC website (djibaviationcivile.com) has minimal content. Djibouti is NOT an ASECNA member so the aim.asecna.aero portal does not cover HD. Procedures currently exist as Jeppesen-sourced PDF charts only; no open official eAIP confirmed live. AIRAC-aligned in principle.

FO.aip_authority: Naviair / Danish Civil Aviation and Railway Authority (Trafikstyrelsen)
FO.notes: Faroe Islands AIP (EKVG/Vágar) is published by Naviair as part of the Denmark/Faroe Islands/Greenland AIP at aim.naviair.dk. Procedures (SID, STAR, IAP) delivered as vector PDF charts (selectable text confirmed via sample AD-2 PDF); no HTML eAIP for procedure sections. Open access, no login required. AIRAC-aligned. Also accessible via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration) for coded data. +1 for portal navigation needed to locate Faroe-specific PDF sections.

GN.aip_authority: Roberts FIR / AGAC (Autorité Guinéenne de l'Aviation Civile)
GN.notes: Guinea is NOT covered by ASECNA eAIP; it falls under the Roberts FIR (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone tri-state agreement). EUROCONTROL IS Online lists Roberts FIR as AIP authority. Roberts FIR website (robertsfir.org) returns 404/offline as of Jun 2026. AIP described as obtainable only by contacting Central AIS Office by email/phone (+231 886 702 427). AGAC website (agac.gov.gn) contains no eAIP or procedure charts. No publicly accessible digital eAIP confirmed. GUCY (Conakry) instrument procedures not publicly indexed online. Score 10: no functional public digital AIP portal; contact-only distribution.

GW.notes: Guinea-Bissau is an ASECNA member state. ILS approach charts for GGOV Bissau/Osvaldo Vieira (RWY 21 ILS Z and ILS X, VAC, APDC) confirmed at aim.asecna.aero/html/eAIP/cartes/atlas/guinee%20bissau/Bissau%20-%20Osvaldo/. Charts are vector PDFs (PDF 1.6, selectable text, metadata referencing amendment AMDT). HTML eAIP sections for GG states share the common ASECNA framework. AIXM 4.5 confirmed. Score 7: same ASECNA eAIP HTML + PDF chart structure as BJ/TG.

LS.notes: Lesotho DCA website (civilair.org.ls) was unreachable (ECONNREFUSED) during research. No active eAIP or online AIP portal found through any search. Lesotho publishes its own AIP and NOTAMs (confirmed by ICAO AFI references). FXMM Moshoeshoe I has IFP charts (visible on Navigraph). AIP appears to be distributed via AIS office contact only. Procedures presumably exist as vector PDF given modern ICAO compliance, but no public download confirmed. Confidence low due to inaccessible official website and lack of online publication evidence.

WS.aip_authority: Samoa MWTI Civil Aviation Division / Aeropath NZ (publisher)
WS.notes: AIP authority is the Director of Civil Aviation under Samoa Ministry of Works, Transport & Infrastructure (MWTI); Aeropath NZ distributes. Free PDF download ($0 NZD) but requires account/checkout. No eAIP HTML or coded data. Charts are vector PDF. +1 for portal friction.

SR.aip_authority: CADSUR (Civil Aviation Department Suriname) / AIS Suriname
SR.notes: AIS Suriname publishes AIP at cadsur.sr/ais (6th edition). Documents appear as PDF downloads; SIDs/STARs and instrument approaches covered. No registration gate found on public pages. Portal navigation required to locate individual chart PDFs per aerodrome (SMJP). Main PDF URL (1 AIP SURINAME 6th EDITION.pdf) returned 404 suggesting reorganization; June 2025 update posted. AIRAC cadence.
